organization.name: Front
organization.notes: Official leadership and company history date founding to 2013. Private venture-backed business; current About reports $204M venture funding and named funds. 2022 Series D announcement identifies historical participants; no public exchange listing or parent established in checked company sources.

pricingTiers.name: Starter
pricingTiers.notes: Lowest paid plan; trial is not free plan. Annual-billed $25/seat/month multiplied by12; up to10 seats, not minimum10. Single-channel type.

pricingTiers.name: Enterprise
pricingTiers.notes: Explicit most popular badge. Annual-billed $105/seat/month multiplied by12. Autopilot usage add-on separate.

pricingTiers.name: Professional
pricingTiers.notes: Closest team/organizational plan, with omnichannel and multiple workspaces. Annual-billed $65/seat/month multiplied by12; up to50 seats, not minimum50.

pricingTiers.name: Enterprise
pricingTiers.notes: Annual-billed $105/seat/month multiplied by12; custom roles and unlimited rules. Autopilot add-on extra.

moats.claim: Accumulated customer conversation history, automation rules and integrations create workflow switching costs across customer-facing teams.

productReasons.claim: Shared inboxes combine ticket assignments and customer conversations for collaborative handling.
Macros and automation rules route repetitive customer work across channels and workspaces.
A public knowledge base and conversation analytics connect self-service content with operational reporting.
